text_source: Within the confines of a lonely room, faintly\n
illuminated in the dim air...
Anju sits alone, staring blankly into space.
Her eyes, once so full of energy, are devoid\n
of life. All that now remains is reflected\n
darkness.
Her mind feels clouded, weighed down by a heavy\n
mist... as though adrift in a dream.
What... What am I doing...?
Why... does my body refuse to move...?
From time to time, questions rise in her mind.
But before they can solidify, they are engulfed\n
by darkness, vanishing like popped bubbles.
Is... Is there anyone here...?
Anyone...?
Suddenly, the door opens with a slam.\n
A shadow falls over Anju's vision, darkening\n
the room further.
Huh...?
She slowly raises her head to see a large,\n
cold-eyed man looking down at her.
Ah... hhhh...
Vurai...
Her lifeless eyes cloud over, ever so slightly,\n
with a hint of fear.
Princess... No, Anju.
Vurai continues to stare down at Anju, but he\n
soon speaks, rumbling voice pitying and\n
disdainful.
You are yet far too small, and far too weak.
What can you protect, with those feeble arms?\n
What can you kill? What can you accomplish?
The answer... is nothing. You are pitiful,\n
you are powerless, and that is all you are.
What... What is he saying...?
Our liege has passed. However, there are none\n
left to take his place.
What are you saying...? I... I am to succeed\n
Father...
Do you think you... you, of all people, can\n
stand and lead us? The Eight Pillar Generals?
What can you possibly show us to earn our\n
loyalty?
Your frail arms, that could snap under the most\n
meager of weights?
Your radiance, barely that of a dying firefly's\n
flickering ass?
Ludicrous.
As Vurai extends his fist, Anju can only stare\n
blankly, her focus drifting in and out.
You have no right to stand above me.
The only one that does... is one who has proven\n
their absolute power.
A new era of war now dawns on our land of\n
Yamato.
This is the will of the heavens.
Only one who can conquer all else may rise to\n
Yamato's summit. One chosen by the heavens!
Ah... hh...
And I... I, Vurai, shall be the one to ascend\n
victorious in this war!
Anju. You will bow before me.
For that is the only path left for one as\n
feeble as you.
You shall become my puppet, and shall serve\n
as a sacrifice on my road to conquest.
Nh... hh... hhh...
No... I will not...
I... I do not wish for Yamato...
...to become... such a place...
Through the mental fog and hazy vision,\n
Anju weakly shakes her head.
Oh? Your pride as the imperial princess will\n
not allow such submission, then?
Very well. For that, you shall have my mercy.
Vurai tosses a single dagger at Anju's feet.
Use it.
If you truly do not wish to live a life of\n
shame, then end your life with your own hands.\n
Now.
Anju picks up the blade with shaking hands,\n
and slowly unsheathes it.
Ah... hhh...
The cold glint of the blade reflects in her\n
empty eyes.
N-No... I... do not wish to...
Her whole body shivers as sweat trickles down\n
her back.
I do not... want to die...\n
I am so afraid...
She can hear a part of her crying out, but her\n
body refuses to obey, as if she is no longer\n
in control.
Please... someone... help...!
The dagger held in her hands slowly inches\n
toward her neck.
Please save me... Father...\n
Oshtor...
The blade's tip slips against her throat almost\n
gently, a trickle of blood trailing down her\n
pale skin.
Help me... Haku!
Princess! You all right!?
Ah...
Rrrgh...
Vurai slowly turns to face us.
Your Highness, are you hurt!?
Looks like we made it just in time, yeah?
Despite our bursting in, Anju only stares\n
blankly ahead, showing no sign of having\n
noticed us...
But looking closer, we can see her eyes\n
welling up with tears.
In her hand she holds a dagger, pointed directly\n
at her own throat.
Nh... ah... hhh...
Anju--
Shit, we barely made it in time...
And there's something wrong with the princess.\n
We have to do something, quick--
What have you done to Her Highness!?
Soldier
Lord Vurai! What was that sound just... Huh!?
Intruders! How did you enter this place!?
SILENCE!
S-Sir!!
Vurai roars at the flustered soldiers,\n
then fixes his gaze on Oshtor.
...Vurai.
So you came after all... Oshtor.\n
This is it. This is what I had hoped to see.
But what will you do now? However powerful you\n
may be, you can barely stand as you are now.
That will be none of your concern.
Hrm?
Sorry to disappoint, but your opponent's\n
over here.
Vurai's gaze flickers momentarily to me, but\n
his hard glare returns to Oshtor almost\n
instantly.
Even now, you still mock me, Oshtor?
Looks like he doesn't think we're worth his\n
time. I wasn't expecting him to take us this\n
lightly.
Well, well, look at the big macho Akuruturuka\n
over here. He's so full of himself, it's kinda\n
refreshing.
Is that so...? You don't think we'll even be\n
a match, eh? Oh, that's just precious...
Rrgh...
You never change, Vurai. You take such pride\n
in your might, and deem all without power to\n
be worthless.
Rule is won through strength. Our liege ruled\n
this land of Yamato with absolute and ineffable\n
power.
I do not deny it. Yet regardless of his\n
strength, our liege never looked down upon\n
others.
By all means, test if this is mere mockery.\n
Or do you fear you will taste defeat for a\n
second time?
You dare--
Ahah...
Indeed... Maybe that is why you lost to Oshtor.
*Crk*
Something snaps at her words. A deadly pressure\n
falls over us, like Vurai holds our hearts in\n
his clenched fist.
Nngh...
...Woman. Do you mean to insult me?
Eep...
Hm? I was just commenting that perhaps that\n
is why you lost.
Strong or not, you will fail if you underestimate\n
your opponent. It seems only natural that he\n
would win against you.
I will say only this: You will never be able\n
to defeat Oshtor. Ever.
Or us, for that matter.
...Such audacity... You run your mouth overmuch,\n
woman.
Aha... Hee hee hee...
Oh, come on... Sure, the plan was to provoke him\n
so he goes all out, but you might be overdoing\n
it here!
Insolent child...
Vurai mutters quietly, then takes a slow step\n
forward.
mask
Very well. Then prove to me... your worth!
Haku...
Yeah, I know.
We have to make him activate his Akuruka's\n
power, so we have a chance to finish him off.
Stay back now, Shinonon.
What're you talkin' about?\n
I wanna fight too!
Thank you, Shinonon. But we need you to stay\n
with the nice lady and Oshtor so you can\n
protect them.
You want me to protect Osh?
Mhm. Can you do that for us?
Hokay, got it. You can leave it to me!
That's my girl. Thanks, bosslady.
You need to stay back, too.\n
Look after Shinonon and Oshtor.
Lady-in-waiting
U-Understood. And... I wish you all the best\n
of luck.
Jachdwalt, Ougi, I want you guys needling him.\n
Keep his attention on you!
Very well. I must say, though, I never dreamed\n
I'd find myself in the thick of such an\n
insane scheme.
Got that right. I thought I was used to the\n
boss's crazy orders, and now we're up against\n
Vurai himself...
Doesn't get any better than this.
Nosuri, Kiwru, I want you on crowd control.\n
Keep his backup at bay.
U-Understood!
You dare hurt Her Highness... Vurai, you are a\n
villain, unfit for your title. I will deliver\n
your judgement.
I... will not falter. I am my sworn brother's--\n
no... the Imperial Guard of the Right,\n
Oshtor's sword!
Nekone, Rulutieh, get the princess as soon as\n
you see an opening. We need to get her away\n
from Vurai.
I need no reminding. Make sure you keep his\n
attention.
Miss Anju... I promise I will save you,\n
no matter what, so please wait a little\n
longer...
Atuy... just do whatever you want.\n
I'm not gonna stop you this time.\n
Go nuts.
Hee hee hee... music to my ears.\n
You're the BEST, love!
...We can't afford to hold back. I promise I'll\n
do anything you two want me to later. Uruuru,\n
Saraana... we're counting on you.
We obey your call without fail.\n
We offer our all to you, Master.
I expected their usual schtick when I said\n
I'd do anything... The strain must be really\n
serious.
...Kuon.
Don't worry. I've got everyone's backs.
You just concentrate on the tactics, Haku.
Thanks... I'll do just that.
Everyone... Let's do this!
Show me the power... of the Akuruturuka.
